GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR BALL PARK INSTALLATION — The power is controled by a switch located on top of the cabinet. Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles. EQUIPMENT PANEL — Located in back box area and are easily serviced by removing back door. To service equipment panel, remove mounting screws and slide panel up and out by means of provided hand slot. Rotate panel in a horizontal plane and push forward into blocks provided on cabinet sides. BALL-STRIKE VOLUME CONTROL — Located on left hand side of T.V. monitor. BACKGROUND VOLUME CONTROL — Located on sound module (PC 589-910) on equipment panel. To increase background sound volume, rotate post as indicated. COIN AND INNING CONTROL SWITCHES — Located on logic board (PC 589-908-1). To adjust innings or method of play, see instructions in back box area. TO SERVICE FRONT DISPLAY INSERT — Remove score glass by opeining, turn buttons in back box area, and pull back locking bars. Remove glass from front by lifting up and out. When changing logic P.C. 589-908-1 or P.C. 589-908-2, please check the following: 1. Proper seating of P.C. 589-908-1 and P.C. 589-908-2 into intermediate P.C. 589-909 (mother board). NOTE: Loose jack connection may cause problems. 2. The 100 ohm pot on power supply 588-905 should be set at 5.1 VDC at logic P.C. 589-908-1 and P.C. 589-908-2. 3. Secure both logic PC boards properly. 4. Check game out electrically. CAUTION THE VOLTAGE SHOULD NEVER EXCEED 5.1 AT THE LOGIC PC AND 5.3 AT THE POWER SUPPLY MIDWAY MFG.
